title: HybridTimberOnSteel
description: HybridTimberOnSteel: Hybrid floor configuration of a timber slab on top of a steel frame of primary and secondary beams.

Slab.description: Surface property defining the construction and thickness of the slab. ISurfaceProperty: Base interface for properties for 2D finite element structural objects such as Panels and FEMeshes.

PrimaryBeam.description: Section of the primary beams (girders) spanning between columns in the local X direction. ISteelSection: Base interface for Steel section types.

SecondaryBeam.description: Section of the secondary (infill) beams spanning between the primary beams in the local Y direction. ISteelSection: Base interface for Steel section types.

PrimaryBeamTopLevel.description: Distance from top of slab to top of primary beam. Set to slab thickness for slab on top but set to zero for within depth of slab. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

SecondaryBeamTopLevel.description: Distance from top of slab to top of secondary beam. Set to slab thickness for slab on top but set to zero for within depth of slab. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

NumSecondary.description: Number of secondary (infill) beams in a bay, counting the beam on one edge of the bay but not the one on the opposite edge. Set to zero for no secondary beams.

IntumescentPaintThicknessPrimary.description: Thickness of intumescent paint covering exposed primary beam steelwork. Allowance used for when computing takeoffs of the configuration. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

IntumescentPaintThicknessSecondary.description: Thickness of intumescent paint covering exposed secondary beam steelwork. Allowance used for when computing takeoffs of the configuration. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

IntumescentPaintMaterial.description: Material of the intumescent paint. Used when computing material takeoffs of the configuration. Material: Physical material to be used for Takeoffs and asigned to Physical elements. Material is capable of storing discipline specific data in Properties.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
